title: Arkret Principal Service Binding
description: Portable accepted-at binding between exactly one PrincipalAuthorityInstance and its Principal Server. It is not a global current-service pointer and cannot be continued to another PCR or Principal Server.

accepted_at_service_binding_core.description: Frozen accepted-at binding core returned by ak.self.principal_service_binding.command.prepare. binding_digest = H('ak.principal-service-binding.v1', the RFC 8785 canonical object formed by every property here except binding_digest). authority_instance selects one PCR; authority_evidence describes only the service signing key, never principal authority. A same-service renewal stays inside the same authority instance.

authority_instance.description: principal_id MUST equal authority_instance.principal_id and service_id MUST equal authority_instance.principal_server_id.

endpoint_origins.description: Canonical HTTPS origins sorted by unsigned UTF-8 bytes. Paths, queries and fragments are forbidden by semantic validation.

service_resolution.description: First-hop route material for service_id. An inline record MUST name the same service_id; a referenced record MUST be fetched and independently verified before endpoint use.

authorization_challenge.description: Opaque service-generated challenge copied from the durable prepare record and included in binding_digest. It is never caller-selected or reused across distinct binding drafts.

predecessor_binding_digest.description: Exact current accepted binding digest replaced by this same-service renewal. Omitted only for the first accepted binding.

accepted_at_service_binding.description: Closed accepted-at snapshot installed by the two-phase self binding operation. principal_authorization_proof is made by a current accepted device/recovery authority from authority_instance and is independently replayable through principal_authorization_evidence; it is never a current DID-controller proof. service_acceptance_proof uses the service key. Neither proof enters binding_digest.

principal_authorization_evidence.description: Must match authority_instance byte-for-byte and authorize principal_authorization_proof at accepted_at.
